title: Raid groups
text:
Parties hold 5 again, and any party leader can turn their party into a raid group of up to 20 heroes for Cinderhold.

✨ Raid groups: the party leader opens the Party window and presses Convert to raid group. Up to 20 players can then join
⬆️ Parties are back to 5 players
⬆️ Cinderhold accepts 5 to 20 heroes. Its bosses grow tougher as more raiders come in, so a big raid still has to fight
⬆️ With more than 7 members, the party frames switch to two compact columns
⬆️ The raid reminder no longer appears when you log in
